item.title: 【Requests】[REQ VID] - Michael Bolton - Go the Distance (1997) VOB / DVD / TV Master
item.description:
I am looking for a high-quality, uncompressed source of Michael Bolton's "Go the Distance" music video from 1997 (the official theme for Disney's Hercules, with footage of Michael and the museum).

I am hoping a collector here has a clean digital transfer from an original 1997 promotional video pool tape (such as Telegenics, Wolfman Jack Video, or a standalone Sony/Columbia BetaSP broadcast master).

- I am NOT looking for the Ricky Martin Spanish version ("No Importa la Distancia").

Thank you so much to anyone who can check their offline archive or digital video pools to help fill this!
item.author: mithradam
